name: Metal Coatings (India) Limited
about: Metal Coatings (India) Limited manufactures and sells cold-rolled steel strips and hot-rolled pickled and oiled steel strips and coils in India. It serves the auto components, consumer durables, electrical equipment, electronics, telecom equipment, engineering products, infrastructure, industrial, white goods, and other industries. Metal Coatings (India) Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in New Delhi, India.
